{{Quote|I'm extremely important, so mind your place!|F-TO|<ref name="Star Wars: DroidWorks">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>}}
'''F-TO''', or '''Fito''', was the chief administrator droid of the [[phrik metal mine]]. F-TO was kept busy by overseeing the other droids at the mine. He oversaw the mine for three cycles. He was known to be demanding, and, according to [[Holocam E|Cammy]], needed "a swift kick in his personality program", but he still proved helpful. After a Rebel's droid ridded the mine of an [[Unidentified Imperial assassin droid|assassin droid]], F-TO begged him to work at the mine. The droid declined the offer.

[[File:F-TO.jpg|250px|F-TO chief administrator of the phrik metal mine]]
